name: NSN (Never Say Never)
verdict: Barcelona sports and entertainment company co-founded by Andrés Iniesta and led by founder-president Joel Borràs; Stoneweg (SWI Group) took a stake in 2025. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: title sponsor of the team it co-owns. Private Spanish company; Stoneweg became a shareholder of NSN in November 2025 (stake not disclosed). No state ownership and no human-rights finding against the company found, so the rating test is not met.
